Method changes worth keeping. 1) ShipmentLink can now be driven entirely programmatically: calling TUF1_AutoCompleteServlet once with credentials, then setting both tvs2OriAC_hideValue and tvs2DesAC_hideValue and calling frmSubmit, submits and returns results. The documented requirement for a real click-and-type seed on the origin box no longer holds. 2) The Maersk routing API field isRoutingAdhoc is true on every routing including proforma TP15 sailings and must not be used as a trigger. 3) Hapag rejects VNCMT and VNTOT with HTTP 400; VNVUT is the working code for the Cai Mep / Vung Tau range. 4) Maersk WC1-WC4 (Pacific Northwest) and AN1-AN3 (Andex) and ONE FP2 all appear on Asia to USEC and Gulf searches as two-leg transshipment or relay routings and have been added to the deny list.
No unknown service code reached three or more in-window sailings on any lane queried. Nothing promoted to the registry.
